verdict.rationale: Jules documents asynchronous cloud-VM execution, plan review and approval before code changes, and notifications when a task needs input, so the core oversight loop exists. Phone use is supported only by one community report of driving Jules from a phone; there is no documented mobile app or mobile approval flow, and plan approval gates work rather than letting it continue in parallel. Missing for 10: first-party mobile app or documented mobile approval, push notifications to phone, evidence that agents keep working while awaiting approval of key decisions, independent corroboration of mobile approvals.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can approve key agent decisions from my phone while agents continue working

citations.quote: Once you submit a task, Jules will generate a plan. You can review and approve it before any code changes are made.
You’ll be notified when the task completes or needs your input.
Jules runs in a virtual machine where it clones your code, installs dependencies, and modifies files.
I've been actually kind-of enjoying using Jules as a way of 'coding' my side project using my phone.
